entries.name: ndarray
entries.rationale: Burn 0.22.0-pre.2 pins ndarray 0.17 while the remainder of the graph resolves ndarray 0.16. Transitive split within the Burn lineage only; no direct dependency on 0.17. Expires with the Burn migration tracked in ADR-0006.

entries.name: colored
entries.rationale: MPL-2.0 (weak copyleft) transitive via burn 0.22.0-pre.2 (burn-tensor). No direct dependency; MPL-2.0 permits combination with permissive code without source disclosure of Reflex itself. Expires with the Burn migration tracked in ADR-0006.

entries.name: option-ext

entries.name: quick-xml
entries.rationale: Transitive via object_store 0.13.2 pinned by DataFusion 54.1 (ADR-0007). Upgrade blocked until Arrow/DataFusion migration. Used for object-store XML metadata parsing in analytics paths only; direct quick-xml 0.41.0 is pinned for reflex-analytics but object_store retains 0.39.4.
evidence: deny.toml [advisories] ignore entries RUSTSEC-2026-0194 and RUSTSEC-2026-0195

entries.name: paste
entries.rationale: Build-time proc-macro transitive via burn-dispatch 0.22.0-pre.2. Crate is archived upstream (dtolnay) and no safe upgrade exists. Compile-time only; does not ship in binaries. Expires with the Burn migration tracked in ADR-0006.
